# Sanitised FortiOS "show full-configuration" excerpt. All credentials are FAKE
# and the trailing "# rule:" annotation names the redaction rule id expected
# to catch it (see fortios.expect.json).
#config-version=FGT60F-7.4.4-FW-build2662-240514:opmode=0:vdom=0:user=admin
config system global
    set alias "fw-branch-01"
    set hostname "fw-branch-01"
    set timezone "US/Central"
end
config system admin
    edit "admin"
        set accprofile "super_admin"
        set vdom "root"
        set password ENC FAKEfortiAdminPasswordBase64AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWx==          # rule: fortios-enc
    next
    edit "netops"
        set accprofile "prof_read_only"
        set vdom "root"
        set password ENC FAKEfortiNetopsPasswordBase64YzAbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrSt==          # rule: fortios-enc
    next
end
config system interface
    edit "wan1"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 203.0.113.30 255.255.255.252
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type physical
        set role wan
    next
    edit "internal"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 10.40.0.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type physical
        set role lan
    next
end
config user local
    edit "vpnuser"
        set type password
        set passwd ENC FAKEfortiVpnUserPasswdBase64ZyXwVuTsRqPoNmLkJiHgFe==             # rule: fortios-enc
    next
end
config user radius
    edit "RADIUS-PROF"
        set server "10.20.30.41"
        set secret ENC FAKEfortiRadiusSecretBase64QwErTyUiOpAsDfGhJkLzXc==              # rule: fortios-enc
    next
end
config vpn ipsec phase1-interface
    edit "BRANCH-VPN"
        set interface "wan1"
        set ike-version 2
        set peertype any
        set proposal aes256-sha256
        set remote-gw 203.0.113.9
        set psksecret ENC FAKEfortiPskSecretBase64ZxCvBnMaSdFgHjKlQwErTy==              # rule: fortios-enc
    next
end
config router bgp
    set as 65200
    set router-id 10.255.200.1
    config neighbor
        edit "203.0.113.29"
            set remote-as 65000
            set password ENC FAKEfortiBgpPasswordBase64PoIuYtReWqLkJhGfDsAzXc==        # rule: fortios-enc
        next
    end
end
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "lan-to-wan"
        set srcintf "internal"
        set dstintf "wan1"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set nat enable
    next
end
